output.source_text: To determine which chord a minor scale fits over for improvisation, isolate scale degrees 1, 3, 5, and 7: 1-b3-5-7 matches minor-major 7 (mM7); 1-b3-5-b7 matches minor 7 (m7); 1-b3-b5-b7 matches half-diminished (m7b5); 1-b3-#5-7 matches minor-major 7 sharp 5 (mM7#5).
